name: TileShift
description: Gen 3 world art for Gen 1/2, plus selectable monochrome Gen 1 and Crystal-based Gen 2 backgrounds in Ruby, Sapphire, Emerald, FireRed and LeafGreen. Expanded Crystal-theme terrain, city buildings and interiors include fully retiled Petalburg and ordinary Hoenn clinic upstairs rooms. Other Gen 3 areas remain partly converted. The Gen 3 theme covers every Gen 1 map and all playable Gen 2 backgrounds. Original pixel scale, entrances, collision, actors, scripts and interactions are preserved.
